questions.question: Solve z^3 = -8. Plot the roots on an Argand diagram and show they form an equilateral triangle

points.text: z^3 = 8e^{ipi} -> z = 2e^{i(pi+2kpi)/3} for k=0,1,2. Roots: 2e^{ipi/3} = 1+isqrt3, 2e^{ipi} = -2, 2e^{i5pi/3} = 1-isqrt3. Distance between any two = sqrt((1-(-2))^2+(sqrt3-0)^2) = sqrt(9+3) = 2sqrt3 -- all equal, equilateral triangle
